_style: Top-down overhead photo, camera pointing straight down at a plain light wooden table, soft even daylight, sharp focus, realistic, 16:9 landscape. No text, no people visible.
_motion: Fixed overhead camera that never moves, zooms or cuts. A single person's hand and forearm enter from the bottom edge of the frame, pick up the object slowly and deliberately, set it down in its final position, then leave the frame. Every other object stays exactly where it is and nothing appears, disappears or changes. No text, no music.
